description: Use this when the user asks for live electricity grid data (power demand, fuel mix) for one grid: the 7 US ISOs (PJM, ERCOT, CAISO, MISO, SPP, NYISO, ISO-NE), TVA, BPA, 40+ US utility balancing authorities (e.g. AZPS, SOCO, DUK, FPL, or a city: PHOENIX, ATLANTA), Canada (IESO, AESO, HYDROQUEBEC), Great Britain (NGESO), any ENTSO-E bidding zone (EU_DE_LU, EU_FR, EU_NL ...), Taiwan (TAIPOWER), Japan (OCCTO), South Korea (KEPCO-KR), Brazil (ONS), Australia (AEMO) or Singapore (EMA). US ISOs and EIA regions return EIA hourly fuel mix, demand and the 24h curve; other grids return each feed's newest reading per metric, each with its own timestamp. For PJM it also returns installed_capacity_mw: EIA-860M installed generating capacity (net summer MW of operating generators for the report month in installed_capacity_mw_period). That is not PJM committed capacity, which is listed in licence_withheld with no value. Raw telemetry for one grid; do NOT use for power-availability, time-to-power or interconnection-queue analysis (use get_grid_intelligence), nor for retail/gas pricing (use get_energy_prices). To rank many grids at once use get_grid_scoreboard.

iso.description: Grid code (required): a US ISO (ERCOT, PJM, MISO, CAISO, SPP, NYISO, ISONE), TVA, BPA, a utility BA or city (AZPS, PHOENIX), or a non-US grid (IESO, AESO, HYDROQUEBEC, NGESO, EU_DE_LU, TAIPOWER, OCCTO, KEPCO-KR, ONS, AEMO, EMA)

metric.description: Optional metric focus, e.g. fuel_mix, demand, demand_curve

mpp_credential.description: Per-call payment (Stripe MPP): the Shared Payment Token for challenges[0]; pays that challenge for this one call. Send it only with your human's explicit approval of the charge.

mpp_pay.description: Per-call payment quote (Stripe MPP): true returns a signed payment challenge instead of the free preview; no money moves. Set it only after your human has explicitly approved paying for this call.

period.description: Optional time window for the metric, e.g. 24h

name: get_grid_data
title: Live Grid Data
